blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A historical marker for Jose Rizal was formally unveiled in Ghent, Belgium, the site where the national hero finished his famous novel “El Filibusterismo,” the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) said. The historical marker, located at Lange Kruisstraat 25, 9000 in Ghent, Belgium, was the house where Rizal stayed as he finished and published the continuation of his earlier novel “Noli Me Tangere.” A formal ceremony was held to commemorate the event last Saturday, Sept. 19, which was led by the NHCP and the Philippine Embassy in the Kingdom of Belgium.
